stem_book: A block of mass 0.1 kg is held against a wall by applying a horizontal force of 5 N on the block. If the coefficient of friction between the block and the wall is 0.5, the magnitude of the friction force acting on the block is (g = 9.8 m/s²) (a) 2.5 N (b) 0.98 N (c) 4.9 N (d) 0.49 N
work: f_max = 0.5·5 = 2.5 N > mg = 0.98 N → static f = mg = 0.98 N
